D4a-08 rule, written before any clustering. (1) The change block is D4a-07's unchanged: selected changes, arrows and link ops lifted as links (half their weight on the evidence node, half on the link), shares within each level, columns held by one defining room dropped, the three levels counting equally. (2) The code block (required): each room's coded concepts, lifted through their second-order theme's placements to third-order themes (a theme under several splits each concept equally), then to fourth-order themes and dimensions; the 1,982 on residue themes count at the third-order level only, the 407 unplaced nowhere; shares within each level (handler's proposal b, taken: rich records must not dominate); nodes only, the arrow links stay in the change block (c, taken); columns held by one defining room dropped. (3) How the blocks combine (a, taken): the two blocks count equally, and within each block the three levels count equally; the squared distance is half the change block's mean squared Hellinger plus half the code block's; so the codes cannot swamp the changes, whatever a room's count of concepts. (4) Kept (f): the floor of 5 selected changes for defining rooms; thin rooms placed by the whole mix of both blocks; the core of 21 kept together, with where each core room's codes alone would place it reported; placement by the whole mix; the count by the merge-height gap and matched-subsample stability against a null that shuffles every column of both blocks, the stability cut carried and the gap's cut given if they disagree. J's literal rule not reported again. (5) The split-half check (d, taken): each concept goes at random to half A or half B (seed 7); the cut is made on the changes with half A at the carried k, and tested on half B by a permutation test of its labels on half-B code shares (999 permutations, seed 8) and by nearest-centre agreement on half B against shuffled labels; the cut on the changes with half B is also made, and the adjusted Rand between the two half cuts reported beside each one's agreement with the D4a-07 change-only cut, since both share the change block. (6) Reported (e): agreement with D4a-07, form B, the raiding core (silhouette in the combined space against random groups of its size, 999, seed 6), the takeover rooms, r/startrek, and for each form whether an account could differ from the global model, judged from its change signature, with the code signature saying what its rooms did.
